title: We Need a Place to PARTY!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Yoooooooo!!!! You are a fucking VR program in an analog world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yoooooooo!!!! You are a fucking VR program in an analog world.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Whoo, sky's a million colors right now. Like I'm looking up through a wicked visualizer. Oooof, now I'm dizzy. I think I need to sit down. No! No time for that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoo, sky's a million colors right now. Like I'm looking up through a wicked visualizer. Oooof, now I'm dizzy. I think I need to sit down. No! No time for that.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Hahaha! I knew you would. We're on the same, what's it called? Brain thing? Wavelength! That's it. We're on the same wavelength.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha! I knew you would. We're on the same, what's it called? Brain thing? Wavelength! That's it. We're on the same wavelength.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Up high? Sooooo many people. You know, as soon as we have a place for them all to party. Ain't no rules at the party mansion, hooo-ah!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Up high? Sooooo many people. You know, as soon as we have a place for them all to party. Ain't no rules at the party mansion, hooo-ah!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Ehhhh, caffeine, nicotine, amphetamine, joosine, morphine, you get where I'm going with this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ehhhh, caffeine, nicotine, amphetamine, joosine, morphine, you get where I'm going with this?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: That's why we need the party mansion! Place to let go. A place to get wild.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's why we need the party mansion! Place to let go. A place to get wild.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: 'Course you are! Because you got the smarts and the drive to wanna sail as high as the sky. Now, get me a place to do it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 'Course you are! Because you got the smarts and the drive to wanna sail as high as the sky. Now, get me a place to do it!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Fine-fine-fine. You don't need to GET me a place, I have one. Just need to upscale it, you know? Get the digs right so the bliss comes natural.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine-fine-fine. You don't need to GET me a place, I have one. Just need to upscale it, you know? Get the digs right so the bliss comes natural.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Sometimes my vision doesn't get transferred correctly and people misinterpret what level I'm playing on. I need you to level it out for me. Get me on the plane of these party people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes my vision doesn't get transferred correctly and people misinterpret what level I'm playing on. I need you to level it out for me. Get me on the plane of these party people.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Insulting??? No! You're the translator. The person that can transcribe my vision into something tangible for normies. It's an important role that not everyone can fill as well as you do... So what do you say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Insulting??? No! You're the translator. The person that can transcribe my vision into something tangible for normies. It's an important role that not everyone can fill as well as you do... So what do you say?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Fuck. Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck. Yes.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Well, look, I'm good at a lot of things, one of them being interior object placement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, look, I'm good at a lot of things, one of them being interior object placement.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey to you too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey to you too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How high are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How high are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I love that greeting!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I love that greeting!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... what's up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... what's up?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel like you injected straight caffeine or something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel like you injected straight caffeine or something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I feel like you injected straight caffeine or something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I feel like you injected straight caffeine or something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm down for a party mansion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm down for a party mansion.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm down for a party mansion.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm down for a party mansion.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Absolutely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Absolutely.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait... what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait... what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have a place for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have a place for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have a place for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have a place for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you want ME to do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you want ME to do that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you want ME to do that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you want ME to do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's kind of insulting?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's kind of insulting?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then you don't need me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then you don't need me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then what's the problem?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what's the problem?
